card.situation:
F--NE Rainwater Basin WMD Mechanical Tree Cutting solicitation from U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service (INTERIOR), small business set-aside, requiring mechanical tree cutting and piling at Peterson WPA, Gosper County, Nebraska within a 90-day period of performance.
Reached the owner because Red Cedar is a Total Small Business / WOSB with NAICS 561730 and grounds maintenance past performance, but the matrix flagged 7 gaps and 2 partials against 20 requirements, yielding a fit score of 0.5294.
reasons_for: Red Cedar qualifies under the Total Small Business set-aside and holds NAICS 561730 in its profile, making it administratively eligible to submit [be4f7e41-b4a3ab61-p11-ac901da1].

Herbicide application experience from the Tinker AFB grounds contract partially satisfies the FWS herbicide-approval requirement, providing a foothold on one technical element [be4f7e41-2fed95a8-p2-36bcb8bd].
A documented QC program with CMMS-logged inspections and CIMS-GB certification demonstrates a quality management culture that partially addresses the QC/QA standard [be4f7e41-2fed95a8-p3-b5c76579].
reasons_against: The solicitation response deadline has already passed (days to close: -3.6), making timely submission of a quote impossible [be4f7e41-3a7dc56e-p1-e7a00397].

The firm has no stated mechanical tree cutting, felling, piling, or forestry equipment capability, and the place of performance in Gosper County, NE is 600+ miles from Oklahoma City, violating the owner's 200-mile distance rule [be4f7e41-2fed95a8-p1-8669d73e].
The period of performance is approximately 90 days (10/01/2026–12/30/2026), which falls well below the owner's required 12-month base period minimum [be4f7e41-b4a3ab61-p3-c5bb1881].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) and EDWOSB-certified firm registered under NAICS 561730 (Landscaping Services) with active federal past performance supporting grounds maintenance across cantonment areas, including mowing, trimming, irrigation management, snow and ice removal, and herbicide application. Our work at Tinker AFB demonstrates our ability to execute outdoor land management services under federal contracts, maintain compliance with applicable codes, and manage herbicide programs in sensitive environments.

Red Cedar brings a structured quality management culture to every engagement: our QC program relies on CMMS-logged inspections, and our supervisors hold OSHA 30 certifications. We are CIMS-GB certified, reflecting our commitment to industry-standard quality and safety practices. We maintain e-Verify enrollment and current SAM representations, including WOSB, EDWOSB, and Total Small Business set-aside eligibility.

For the NE Rainwater Basin WMD Mechanical Tree Cutting requirement at Peterson WPA, Red Cedar would furnish all labor, supervision, transportation, and equipment necessary to perform work within the period of performance. We understand that all work must comply with U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service protocols, that herbicide use requires prior FWS approval, and that pile placement must meet the 100-yard interior boundary setback. Any anticipated subcontractors would be disclosed at time of quote submission per solicitation requirements.

We welcome the opportunity to discuss this requirement further. Point of contact: Red Cedar Facility Services | jeremy_riva@ios.doi.gov for submission.
questions_for_co: Regarding the commercial land management experience requirement [be4f7e41-2fed95a8-p1-f8794be8]: Will the government accept demonstrated grounds maintenance experience that includes brush and vegetation management as a substitute for dedicated tree-cutting and piling experience, or is prior mechanical tree-felling work strictly required?

Regarding FWS protocols [be4f7e41-2fed95a8-p1-6ba66328]: Can the contracting officer provide or reference the specific FWS protocols and any site-specific work standards that the contractor will be required to follow at Peterson WPA, so offerors can assess compliance requirements prior to submission?

Regarding the 90-day completion requirement and period of performance [be4f7e41-b4a3ab61-p3-c5bb1881 / be4f7e41-2fed95a8-p2-87ad7aa0]: Is the 10/01/2026 start date firm, or is there flexibility for a contractor mobilizing from outside Nebraska to begin work within the first week of October and still meet the 12/30/2026 delivery deadline?

Regarding pile placement [be4f7e41-2fed95a8-p2-11d9b94b]: Will the government provide a site map or marked boundaries at Peterson WPA to assist contractors in verifying the 100-yard interior setback requirement, or is the contractor solely responsible for determining boundary lines prior to piling?

Regarding SAM representations [be4f7e41-b4a3ab61-p11-677f2a5b]: Does the contracting officer require that SAM representations be validated or updated specifically before quote submission for this solicitation, or is a currently active SAM registration with no pending expiration sufficient?

Regarding IPP invoicing [be4f7e41-b4a3ab61-p5-8f84bb86]: Can the contracting officer confirm which specific documents must be attached to IPP invoices for this contract, and whether a waiver request is available if the contractor encounters IPP registration issues prior to award?
